node.title: Re^5: Authorizing with NTLM - Problem Domain
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Then I'm out of ideas (and time) for the moment, sorry :-( Best I can do is suggest to have a look at the [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Dist/Display.html?Name=NTLM|issue tracker], at least one of the tickets has some discussion in it, and to trace a successful request with [http://www.wireshark.org/|Wireshark] and compare it to a failed request and see what the difference is.
